An independently written group-action computation enumerated all 1920 signed simplicial Lefschetz traces, finding character sum 0 and squared sum 5760. Fourier projection onto the three translation-dual orbits of sizes 1,5,10 identifies wedge^2 U5 (dim 6), epsilon4 tensor U4 (induced dim 15), and sign3 (induced dim 10); their Clifford little-group irreducibility and dimensions exhaust b2=31. Rational transfer after barycentric subdivision gives acyclic reduced G-quotient; no integral assertion is inferred.
